summary: The review was procedurally sound but is under-tiered for what it found.

findings.title: An upgradeable proxy was reviewed at Tier 2
findings.detail: The initiation set Tier 2 with the rationale that upgradeability was unknown and that the MA seat should raise the tiering if CAA established it. CAA has established it. RBM-003 section 8 makes anything with an upgradeable proxy Tier 3 by construction, requiring six specialists; this review seated four, with ADA and LQA omitted because their gates had no implementation at initiation. The review is therefore procedurally insufficient for its own subject, and the decision must not read as a Tier 3 result.
findings.remediation_requirement: Re-convene at Tier 3 with all six specialists, or record the decision as explicitly under-tiered and non-comparable to a Tier 3 review of the same artefact.
